Effekseer WebGL/WASM runtime for the fire trial.

Upstream: https://github.com/effekseer/EffekseerForWebGL
Pinned source commit: e8c3ce076644789918695b0cba0031461c817890 (docs/effekseer.js and docs/effekseer.wasm). Compatible portable editor: release 170e.

MIT license retained in LICENSE.txt. SHA-256 hashes are recorded in provenance.json. Runtime files are lazy-loaded from the same host only when the Goblin event is opened. No CDN or API key is used.
